title: Deploy on merge: CMS app builds main automatically, no personal credentials
description: Enable auto-build on the CMS Amplify app's main branch in the app-shell template (or a GitHub Actions workflow with an OIDC role, like Sierrendipity's CI). Merging to main must deploy the backend with no human AWS step. Find out why auto-build is off on d7s858igkyct5 before changing it. Done: a merged no-op PR on Anth.us-Papyrus produces a successful CMS main job without anyone starting it.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Findings (2026-10-14, read-only). Auto-build is off by hand, not by template: the app-shell template sets enableAutoBuild true on the main and staging branches; CloudFormation drift on amplify-app-shell-anth-us-cms shows Branch/EnableAutoBuild expected true, actual false. CloudTrail: 2026-10-12 09:00 repository connected in the console (UpdateApp), 09:03 UpdateApp + UpdateBranch main enableAutoBuild=false by CLI (the console-connect repair); staging branch updates 11:03-11:34 left it off. The Amplify branch-linker custom resource re-sends the branch's existing values, so it does not flip it back. The GitHub push webhook (amplify-webhooks, push events) on AnthusAI/Anth.us-Papyrus is active (last delivery 202), so enabling auto-build is a single update-branch call; no site.json change is needed because the template already says true (a later CDK deploy of the shell would also turn it on). Only anth-us-cms is connected to that repo in papyrus-production. NOT enabled: waiting for Ryan's go. Steps: assert account 712236451410; aws amplify update-branch --app-id d7s858igkyct5 --branch-name main --enable-auto-build; merge a no-op PR; confirm job starts and succeeds. Rollback: update-branch --no-enable-auto-build.

right_now_summary: The CMS main branch now builds automatically after merges without personal AWS credentials.
